consequence.statement: On a Kubernetes cluster older than v1.16.0, prometheus-operator cannot be installed or upgraded because it uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions, which require Kubernetes >= v1.16.0.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade the Kubernetes cluster to v1.16.0 or later before upgrading prometheus-operator.

assertion.statement: prometheus-operator 0.86.0 uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions and therefore requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0.
